name: Gaunts
descriptionTemplate:
{derived:Gaunts} are Pontos's Buff Cards, with 3 types: {derived:Raid-Gaunt}, {derived:Vex-Gaunt}, and {derived:Slay-Gaunt}. When generating Permanent {derived:Gaunts}, if the Permanent {derived:Gaunts} exceed 6, randomly upgrade 1 into a "Conjoined {derived:Gaunts}" with +1 Arithmetica Cost but takes effect 1 additional time. A "Conjoined {derived:Gaunts}" counts as 2 {derived:Gaunts} in the deck.
If all {derived:Gaunts} have been upgraded, place 1 {Adv. Insight} with {Destroy} into hand.
